projects.name: HireMeAI
highlights: Built a chatbot that answers recruiter questions only from my resume, with streamed responses; the resume is parsed once into a strict JSON schema and cached by a hash of file, prompt and model.
Wrote a golden-set eval that caught silent data loss from schema gaps and a brittle post-processing filter; added 20 pytest tests with the LLM mocked, so they run free in about a second.

Hardened it for public use: phone number withheld from the model, prompt-injection and XSS defenses, input caps, and per-IP plus global rate limiting after finding and fixing an X-Forwarded-For spoofing bypass.

projects.name: MyRecipeApp
highlights: Integrated Spoonacular REST API using Retrofit with structured error handling and JSON parsing across multiple endpoints.
Designed features including recipe search, favorites, and an automated shopping list that aggregates ingredients from saved recipes.

projects.name: Kometo
highlights: Developed a Zomato-inspired Android application with 8+ screens using Jetpack Compose, implementing type-safe navigation and reusable UI components for scalability.
Integrated Firebase Authentication (Google Sign-In + Email) with persistent user sessions, ensuring reliable login experience across app restarts.

projects.name: MyWishlist
highlights: Built a fully offline Android application using Room Database, supporting filtering, tagging, and search without network dependency.
Implemented reactive UI using Kotlin Flow and StateFlow to deliver real-time updates without manual refresh.
